history.startLabelAr: من أول يوم في البيانات المتاحة

rule.A: traded value > 2x median of previous 60 sessions
rule.B: close in top third of day range (inclusive: (close-low)/(high-low) >= 2/3 - 1e-9)
rule.C: 10-session up-day volume share > 60% and close > SMA20
rule.unit: exact combination of met conditions (A,B,C: 7 non-zero combos); zero met = no calculation
rule.events: a day is an event for a combination only if more than 5 sessions passed since the previous event of the SAME combination. n = events; rawDays = all days in that state
rule.closureFilter: forward windows (5/10/20 sessions) that cross a MARKET-WIDE stretch of more than 10 calendar days without any trading in the 96-stock union are excluded from the return statistics and listed in excluded20 with the reason. market closure = the window crosses the market-wide gap 2011-01-27 to 2011-03-23 (documented closure; this includes a stock whose own gap starts 2011-01-27 and ends on or after 2011-03-23). data gap = it crosses the market-wide gap 2002-10-08 to 2002-10-24 (فجوة بيانات, no evidence of a closure). A stock own missing days that are not a market-wide gap do not exclude anything
rule.glitchFilter: forward windows containing a |daily move| > 25% day are excluded from the return statistics
rule.noPooling: statistics come only from this stock's own history; no pooled fallback; n is always shown, also 0 and 1
